description: mapypokrytia.teleoff.gov.sk: telecommunications datasets is a collection of datasets listed in INSPIRE Discovery Service Slovakia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by mapypokrytia.teleoff.gov.sk. Coverage: the area served by mapypokrytia.teleoff.gov.sk. The listing groups 44 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about telecommunications; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Pokrytie signálom Orange Slovensko 1800MHz 2G 2026 Q1; Pokrytie signálom Slovak Telekom 800MHz 4G 2026 Q1; Pokrytie signálom O2 Slovakia 900MHz 2G 2025 Q4; Pokrytie signálom Orange Slovensko 700MHz 5G 2026 Q1. Formats seen: WMS, WMTS, WCS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.sk). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-csw-sk.
